title: Mitigation of Measurement-Induced State Transitions via a Fast-Load and Fast-Clear Readout
summary: High-fidelity and rapid qubit readout is essential for superconducting quantum processors, typically realized through the quantum non-demolition (QND) dispersive interaction within a qubit-resonator architecture. However, the achievable readout speed and fidelity are fundamentally limited by measurement-induced state transitions (MIST). For a transmon qubit, MIST is highly sensitive to the offset charge $n_g$ due to the charge dispersion of its higher-lying energy levels.
